amendments.normalized_body: crates/tank_core/tests/cycling.rs:965-1015: `per_guild_monod_uses_concentration_not_total` is tautological. It computes `tan_total = tan_conc * volume_l` (and the same for NO2/DOC/DO), immediately divides by the same `volume_l`, and then compares identical `monod(...)` expressions. The test never calls `step_nitrogen_cycle` or any shared concentration helper, so a regression back to total-mass K_s handling would still pass. Replace it with a test that exercises the production nitrogen-cycle path or the actual helper used by that path.

crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:333-335: `loader_range_diagnostics_use_explicit_warning_lines` was weakened to only assert that some warning exists. After the field rename, the test no longer checks the warning payload at all, so emitting the wrong parameter id/value or accidentally reintroducing bad normalization would still pass. Restore an assertion on the actual warning content for `aob_k_tan_mg_n_per_l`.
